description: The PATIENTS table contains demographic information for patients in the database. It includes a unique patient identifier (SUBJECT_ID), gender, date of birth (DOB), dates of death from various sources (DOD, DOD_HOSP, DOD_SSN), and an expiration flag indicating patient mortality.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient in the database.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: The gender of the patient, either 'F' for female or 'M' for male.

columns.name: DOB
columns.description: The patient's date of birth.

columns.name: DOD
columns.description: The patient's date of death.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: The date of death as recorded by the hospital.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: The date of death as recorded by the Social Security Administration.

columns.name: EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether the patient has expired (1) or is still alive (0).

description: The ADMISSIONS table contains information about patient hospital admissions, including admission and discharge times, admission types and locations, insurance details, demographic information (language, religion, marital status, ethnicity), diagnoses, and mortality flags. It provides a comprehensive overview of each patient's hospital stay, linking patient identifiers to specific admission details and outcomes.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMITTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DEATHTIME
columns.description: Date and time of the patient's death, if it occurred during the hospital stay. If the patient did not die during the stay, this field is null.

columns.name: ADMISSION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of admission, e.g., ELECTIVE, EMERGENCY, URGENT.

columns.name: ADMISSION_LOCATION
columns.description: Location from which the patient was admitted, e.g., EMERGENCY ROOM ADMIT, TRANSFER FROM OTHER HEALT.

columns.name: DISCHARGE_LOCATION
columns.description: Location to which the patient was discharged, e.g., HOME, DISCH-TRAN TO PSYCH HOSP.

columns.name: INSURANCE
columns.description: Type of insurance the patient has, e.g., Private, Medicare, Self Pay.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: The primary language of the patient. Note: the language is represented by an abbreviation.

columns.name: RELIGION
columns.description: The patient's religion.

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS
columns.description: The patient's marital status.

columns.name: ETHNICITY
columns.description: The patient's ethnicity.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient was registered in the emergency department.

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient left the emergency department.

columns.name: DIAGNOSIS
columns.description: The diagnosis recorded for the patient during the admission.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the patient expired in the hospital (1) or not (0).

columns.name: HAS_CHARTEVENTS_DATA
columns.description: Indicates whether chartevents data is available for this patient's admission (1) or not (0).

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in ADMISSIONS references SUBJECT_ID in PATIENTS, linking admissions to patients.

description: The ICUSTAYS table provides information on individual ICU stays for patients within the database. It includes identifiers for the patient, hospital admission, and specific ICU stay, along with details about the source database, care units, ward IDs, admission and discharge times, and the length of stay in the ICU. This table allows for analysis of ICU utilization, patient flow, and length of stay patterns.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient in the dataset.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each ICU stay.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: The database source from which the data was obtained, e.g., 'metavision' or 'carevue'.

columns.name: FIRST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The first care unit the patient was admitted to during the ICU stay (e.g., MICU, CSRU, CCU, TSICU, SICU, NICU).

columns.name: LAST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The last care unit the patient was in during the ICU stay (e.g., TSICU, NICU, CCU, MICU, SICU, CSRU).

columns.name: FIRST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the first ward the patient was admitted to.

columns.name: LAST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the last ward the patient was in.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was admitted to the ICU.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was discharged from the ICU.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: The length of stay in the ICU, in days.

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in ICUSTAYS references SUBJECT_ID in PATIENTS, linking ICU stays to patients.
HADM_ID in ICUSTAYS references HADM_ID in ADMISSIONS, linking ICU stays to hospital admissions.

description: The SERVICES table contains information on patient transfers between different hospital services during their admissions. It tracks the patient's previous and current service assignments, along with the date and time of the transfer, linking patients (SUBJECT_ID) and hospital admissions (HADM_ID) to specific service transitions.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for each patient receiving a service.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Identifier for each hospital admission during which a service was provided.

columns.name: TRANSFERTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient's service was transferred.

columns.name: PREV_SERVICE
columns.description: The service the patient was on prior to the current transfer (e.g., VSURG, NSURG, CMED).

columns.name: CURR_SERVICE
columns.description: The service the patient is currently on (e.g., ORTHO, OBS, NMED).

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in SERVICES references SUBJECT_ID in PATIENTS, linking services to patients.
HADM_ID in SERVICES references HADM_ID in ADMISSIONS, linking services to hospital admissions.

description: The TRANSFERS table contains data on patient transfers within the hospital, including admissions, discharges, and transfers between different care units and wards. It provides timestamps for arrival and departure (INTIME, OUTTIME) and calculates the length of stay (LOS) for each transfer event. The table links to other patient data via SUBJECT_ID, HADM_ID, and ICUSTAY_ID, and specifies the data source (DBSOURCE) and type of event (EVENTTYPE). This table allows tracking patient movement and resource utilization within the hospital.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: The patient identifier.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: The hospital admission identifier.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: The ICU stay identifier.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: Source database for the event, such as 'carevue' or 'metavision'.

columns.name: EVENTTYPE
columns.description: Type of event, e.g., 'admit', 'transfer', or 'discharge'.

columns.name: PREV_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's previous care unit, such as 'SICU' (Surgical Intensive Care Unit).

columns.name: CURR_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's current care unit, such as 'SICU' (Surgical Intensive Care Unit).

columns.name: PREV_WARDID
columns.description: Ward identifier for the patient's previous ward.

columns.name: CURR_WARDID
columns.description: Ward identifier for the patient's current ward.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: The timestamp of when the patient was admitted.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: The timestamp of when the patient was discharged.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: Length of stay, calculated as the duration between INTIME and OUTTIME, measured in days.

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in TRANSFERS references SUBJECT_ID in PATIENTS, linking transfers to patients.
HADM_ID in TRANSFERS references HADM_ID in ADMISSIONS, linking transfers to hospital admissions.
